Notification sent when in-progress authentication is abandoned without its callbacks running:

(after the auth UI has been dismissed and the auth sessions reset) or the disconnect of the scene hosting it. Callbacks of the abandoned authentication are never invoked, so observers waiting on one (e.g. a refresh token migration) should treat it as cancelled.
